description: The Clinical AI Benchmark Atlas (CABA) is a registry of 58 public clinical AI benchmarks named by 13 evaluation suites and by frontier model reports. Up to 200 items from each benchmark carry RCQ-Map labels (10,659 items), with a comparison of each benchmark's task mix against real clinical queries. Benchmark items are not redistributed; scripts rebuild them from each benchmark's own release. Version 1.0.0 accompanies the preprint: Vishwanath et al., Clinician use of language models diverges from how the models are evaluated, arXiv:2610.11069 (2026), https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2610.11069.
access_conditions: Files will be opened when the accompanying manuscript is posted as a preprint. Editors and reviewers may request access.
